europe_note: Turkey, Russia, the Republic of Georgia and Israel are in Europe, which is where their basketball is played and how their players are written about, rather than on the line a map would draw.
latin_america_note: Latin America here is the standard definition: the Spanish-, Portuguese- and French-speaking countries of the Americas, which puts Haiti in and Jamaica out.
readme: Nationality as data.json spells it, to the region whose page counts that player. Read by scripts/factoids.py, which ranks inside a region the same way it ranks inside a country, and by the prerender, which links a country page to its region. A nationality missing from here joins no region page, so adding a country is adding a line.

regions_without_pages.caribbean: The English-speaking Caribbean is not Latin America, so these countries keep their own country pages and the international page, and nothing calls Deandre Ayton a Latin American.
regions_without_pages.north-america: The United States is the comparison set the whole database already is, and Canada on its own is a country page. Neither needs a region page, and a Canadian is on the international page like every other non-American.
